command:
BB=/bin/busybox
echo POST_BOOT_BEGIN
$BB cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
$BB cat /proc/uptime
$BB cat /proc/ssboot/state
$BB cat /etc/ld.so.preload
$BB md5sum /usr/lib/libnewmenu_exp.so
$BB grep ' /usr ' /proc/mounts
for pid in 149 157; do
 echo "PID=$pid"
 $BB cat /proc/$pid/comm 2>&1
 $BB grep -E 'libnewmenu|zve10_agent' /proc/$pid/maps 2>&1
done
for f in /log/newmenu.log /tmp/newmenu.log /etc/newmenu.log; do
 if [ -f "$f" ]; then
  echo "LOG=$f"
  $BB wc -c < "$f"
  $BB sed -n '1,100p' "$f"
 fi
done
echo POST_BOOT_END
